title: The 16 Best Slow Cookers
metaDescription: Our 16 picks for slow cookers, with key specs, strengths and limitations for each, based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.
lede: We looked at slow cookers using manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. Each pick lists what it does well and where it falls short, so you can match it to how you'll use it.

products.name: Crock-Pot SCCPVL610-S 6-Quart Cook and Carry Programmable
products.blurb: Key specs: 6-quart oval stoneware insert, Programmable digital timer, up to 20 hours, Auto-switch to keep-warm at cycle end.
strengths: Programmable timer with auto-switch to keep-warm, essential for working households
22,000+ Amazon ratings at 4.6 average, the highest-reviewed model in the category
